messages.subject: Pennington v Crossfield — Letter Before Action (for approval / sent)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Grace,

I attach the Letter Before Action to Crossfield, which Sarah has approved. It sets out the breach (substitution of grade 430 for 316L), summarises the heads of loss totalling £2,359,600, and gives them 21 days to admit liability and put forward proposals. We've asked them to preserve documents and to disclose the mill certificates and machining records.

Unless you tell us otherwise we'll send it today by post and email. We'll let you know as soon as they respond.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
